verdict.rationale: Decagon's Insights & Reporting lets leaders ask open-ended questions over conversations (e.g. "Why are customers requesting refunds?") and use heatmaps to spot spikes or dips in metrics. Watchtower reviews every interaction against custom criteria and surfaces what matters, which gives partial monitoring for issue signals. However, the evidence never describes automatic topic clustering or proactive early detection of emerging product issues before volume spikes; spike identification appears reactive and query-driven. Missing for 10: automatic topic clustering of conversations, proactive emerging-issue/anomaly alerting before spikes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
